label: Bible Study
prompt: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without _____ of the church unto God for him.
verse: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
note: Peter in Herod's prison, the church on its knees — an angel showed up that night.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for _____ and might are his:
verse: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
note: Daniel's praise after God revealed the king's dream to him in a night vision.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he _____: for he hath been dead four days.
verse: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
note: Practical Martha objected to opening Lazarus' tomb: four days in, 'he stinketh' — the KJV doesn't sugarcoat it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were _____ until the going down of the sun.
verse: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
note: Israel won against Amalek only while Moses' arms stayed up — so Aaron and Hur held them, one on each side.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And David _____ all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
verse: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
note: At Ziklag David lost everything; after he 'encouraged himself in the LORD' (30:6), he 'recovered all.'
